code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, LDH), and mild transaminitis. These findings suggest a significant systemic inflammatory response, possibly due to infection or another acute process. The low protein may indicate acute phase response or mild protein loss. Close clinical correlation and further evaluation for underlying causes (e.g., severe infection, viral illness, or inflammatory disease) are recommended.
